items.title: ISWI/CHRAC orchestrates sequential chromatin-remodeling activities by mobilizing DNA polymerase ε for homologous recombination
items.author: Ayako Ui
items.content: CHRAC17, a key coordinator of chromatin remoder and DNA polymerase ε (Polε), orchestrates sequential chromatin remodeling, nucleosome assembly and sliding, to promote RAD51-mediated HR and mobilize Polε, thereby maintaining genome stability and conferring resistance to PARP inhibitors.

items.title: Citizen science reveals patterns of distributional decline and expansion across 1864 native vascular plant species in Kanagawa, Japan
items.author: Tetsukazu Yahara
items.content: A long-term citizen science project in Kanagawa Prefecture, Japan, reveals that from 1979 to 2017, distribution ranges contracted in 44.8% and expanded in 36.9% of all 1,864 native vascular plant species occurring in the prefecture.

items.title: Glycine conjugates of indole-3-carboxylates are aryl hydrocarbon receptor ligands
items.author: Gary H. Perdew
items.content: Glycine conjugates of indole-3-acetic acid and indole-3-propionic acid made by the host and/or the microbiome are Ah receptor agonists.

items.title: Performance anxiety is associated with uncertainty-dependent reward and punishment learning biases in skilled performers
items.author: Maria Herrojo Ruiz
items.content: Predisposition to performance anxiety manifests as biases in learning from reward and punishment, accompanied by altered regulation of reinforcement-driven motor variability and associated with changes in frequency-domain EEG activity.

items.title: CGP60474, a novel MITD1-targeted inhibitor for bladder cancer progression via CDK4/cyclin D1 pathway modulation
items.author: Zhiping Wang
items.content: Identification of MITD1 as a driver of bladder cancer progression and its inhibitor CGP60474 establishes a new target and a candidate for therapy development.

items.title: Tn5-EGIM: efficient Tn5 transposon mutagenesis to identify non-essential bacteriophage genes for genome minimization and engineering
items.author: Yuran Zhang
items.content: A transposon mutagenesis system was constructed by using an essential phage gene as the selection marker, enabling efficient enrichment of transposon mutants for phage gene essentiality analysis and phage engineering.

items.title: The gut microbiome of Haemaphysalis longicornis mediates detoxification of the plant-derived insecticide Cinnamaldehyde
items.author: Xiaolong Yang
items.content: The gut microbiome of Haemaphysalis longicornis mediates detoxification of the plant-derived insecticide Cinnamaldehyde

items.title: A descending cortical–brainstem pathway links emotional state to pain sensitivity
items.author: Di Mu
items.content: This study uses tracing, electrophysiology, calcium imaging, and circuit manipulation to examine a medial prefrontal cortex to parabrachial nucleus pathway in mouse pain models. The pathway links aversive states to pain hypersensitivity and contributes to pain-anxiety comorbidity.
